senses.definition: A metal that is a combination of two or more elements, at least one of which is a metal, a base metal.
(archaic) A metal of lesser value, mixed with a metal of greater value.

senses.definition: An admixture; something added which stains, taints etc.

quotes.text: Metrodorus said that in sadnesse there is some aloy of pleasure.

quotes.text: The sole grievance and alloy thus removed in the prospect of Harriet’s welfare, she was really in danger of becoming too happy for security.

senses.definition: To mix or combine; often used of metals.
To reduce the purity of by mixing with a less valuable substance.
examples: to alloy gold with silver or copper, or silver with copper

senses.definition: (figurative) To impair or debase by mixture.

quotes.text: In seasons of cheerfulness, no temper could be more cheerful than hers, or possess, in a greater degree, that sanguine expectation of happiness which is happiness itself. But in sorrow she must be equally carried away by her fancy, and as far beyond consolation as in pleasure she was beyond alloy.
